label: ENGINEERING TEST - production container verification on a throwaway Docker volume. All accounts, shipments and plots are engineering fixtures; plot geometries are coordinate probe boxes, not farms.
environment: Docker Engine 29.1.3 inside WSL2 (Ubuntu 24.04) on Windows 11; image built from deploy/Dockerfile (node:24.13.1-bookworm-slim, pnpm prune --prod); 202 MB content, 929 MB unpacked
run: docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8790:8787 -v lothold_eng_data:/data --env-file <fresh random EVIDENCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY and DOWNLOAD_SIGNING_KEY> -e LOTHOLD_INSTANCE=engineering -e PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:8790 -e CHAIN_ANCHORING=off lothold:local. No AI key, chain key or project secret was passed to the container.

defectFound.symptom: The first image crashed at startup: Cannot find module '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans/files/ibm-plex-sans-latin-400-normal.woff'
defectFound.cause: The PDF generator loads the IBM Plex Sans font files at runtime, but the package was a devDependency and was removed by `pnpm prune --prod`.
defectFound.fix: Moved @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans to dependencies; added tests/unit/runtime-deps.test.ts, which fails if any package used by server/ or core/ is not a runtime dependency.

datasets: The three rasters were copied onto the volume (/data/snapshots, 431 MB). At startup the server verified each against its pinned SHA-256: hansen_lossyear d481e6be…, hansen_datamask 38278ad7…, jrc_gfc2020 33547f27… (all match).
seedChecks (scripts/container-verify.ts: datasets present, sizes match, hashes equal pinned values
source CSV and plot GeoJSON uploaded and confirmed
environmental analysis ran on the real rasters inside the container: ENG-PLOT-A NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, 47 of 1600 pixels with 2021-2025 loss (identical to the native run)
supplier request PDF generated and downloaded (valid %PDF header)
uploaded CSV downloaded back and decrypted byte for byte (SHA-256 equal)

recoveryChecks (scripts/container-verify.docker restart: pass: login, shipment, unchanged evaluation, byte-identical stored PDF and upload, audit history
recoveryChecks (scripts/container-verify.WSL VM shut down while idle and restarte: the container came back by its restart policy (unless-stopped) and passed the next checks
recoveryChecks (scripts/container-verify.migrations: schema_migrations holds [1 'initial schema'] after each restart; no re-application; journal_mode wal; PRAGMA integrity_check ok
recoveryChecks (scripts/container-verify.hard kill (SIGKILL) while a forest-analy: the job was 'running', attempt 1, at the moment of the kill. After restart its lease expired and attempt 2 succeeded (NO_POST_2020_LOSS_OBSERVED on a fresh probe box). Recovery waited for the lease: about 2 minutes from kill to result.

notCovered: hosting on Fly.io or any other platform (not deployed; not authorised)
TLS termination and the Caddy configuration (deploy/Caddyfile) were not exercised
npm run data:fetch inside the container (rasters were copied from the local verified snapshot instead of downloaded)
